name: legal-lens-fixture-v1
description: Small labelled query set over evaluation/corpus (paraphrased statute excerpts). It exercises the evaluation framework and gives directional signal only; build a larger set over the real corpus before drawing production conclusions.

examples.query: What is the punishment for cheating under Section 420 IPC?
What does Article 21 of the Constitution protect?
How is an FIR recorded for a cognizable offence?
Can a person seek anticipatory bail before arrest?
What is the BNS equivalent of Section 420 IPC?
Explain the exceptions under which culpable homicide is not murder
Is dishonest concealment of facts a deception for the offence of cheating?
What reasonable restrictions can the State impose on freedom of speech under Article 19?
What can a person do if the police refuse to record information about a cognizable offence?
Which BNS section replaced IPC 302 and what punishment does it prescribe?
Compare the definitions of culpable homicide and murder under the IPC and explain why the distinction matters for punishment
Compare IPC 420 and BNS 318 and explain how the change affects a person accused of cheating before and after July 2024
How do Articles 14, 19 and 21 together protect personal liberty and what restrictions apply?
Compare the punishment for theft and the punishment for murder under the old and new criminal codes
